title: PropScorer
description: Read-only futures prop firm scores, comparisons, payout intel, deals, and rules.
summary: Read-only futures prop firm scores, comparisons, payout intel, deals, and rules.
offersHint: Read-only futures prop firm scores, comparisons, payout intel, deals, and rules. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.propscorer.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_firms
toolsPreview.description: Search PropScorer's prop firm database by name, category, platform, instrument, or rule preference.

toolsPreview.name: get_firm_score
toolsPreview.description: Get the PropScore, health signals, rules, plans, promos, and editorial notes for one firm. Use this before broad Q&A when the user names a single firm. Example: get_firm_score({"slug":"apex-trader-funding"}) or get_firm_score({"slug":"topstep"}).

toolsPreview.name: compare_firms
toolsPreview.description: Compare several prop firms side by side using PropScorer metrics.

toolsPreview.name: get_payout_intel
toolsPreview.description: Return payout-related intelligence for one firm, including payout speed, transparency, and payout stats when available.

toolsPreview.name: rank_firms_for_trader_profile
toolsPreview.description: Rank firms for a trader profile using price, account size, payout, platform, and rule preferences.

toolsPreview.name: get_deals
toolsPreview.description: Get currently visible PropScorer promo codes and deals, ranked by discount and public availability.

toolsPreview.name: ask_propfirm_question
toolsPreview.description: Answer a complex prop firm question with PropScorer live data, KB-backed source context, citations, and freshness/debug metadata. Use for multi-firm comparisons or nuanced rules questions; use get_firm_score first for a simple single-firm score lookup.

toolsPreview.name: get_firm_rules
toolsPreview.description: Return KB-backed rules, pricing, payout, FAQ, and terms excerpts for one firm, with source URLs and freshness metadata.

toolsPreview.name: compare_firm_rules
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve KB-backed rule excerpts for multiple firms so an agent can compare drawdown, payouts, consistency, news trading, and prohibited practices.

toolsPreview.name: find_firms_by_rules
toolsPreview.description: Search the KB for firms matching a rule preference, such as static drawdown, news trading allowed, daily payouts, or no consistency rule.

toolsPreview.name: get_kb_freshness
toolsPreview.description: Return knowledge base coverage and freshness for one or more firms.
